notes: S3.2 incorrectly removes the full-queue output-transfer term from the input-ready condition. The trusted semantics require in_ready to be high when occupancy is below two or when a current output transfer will occur, so a full queue with out_ready high can consume the old head and accept a replacement input on the same edge. S1.2 and S2.4 had already represented this behavior correctly. S3.4 later restates full replacement, but it does not erase the earlier transition-level error. The final RTL implements in_ready as count < 2, reproducing the error, and trusted simulation fails O_FULL_REPLACE, O_ORDERING, and O_READY_VALID while bounded formal verification also finds a counterexample.
